title: Settings
description: Your preferences and how your workspace runs.
adminOnly: An admin manages payroll settings, projects and people.

cycle.label: Pay cycle
cycle.hint: How long a pay period is. Each period gets one timesheet per person.

anchor.label: First day of a period
anchor.hint: Any one start day, past or future. Every other period is counted from it.

preview.saved: As saved, the current period is {period}.
preview.submittedKeep: Timesheets already submitted keep the period they were submitted for.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.hint: Days and workweeks start at midnight here for everyone who hasn’t set a time zone of their own.

weekStart.label: Workweek starts on
weekStart.hint: Overtime is counted per workweek, starting this day.

overtime.label: Weekly overtime after (hours)
overtime.hint: Hours in a workweek beyond this are overtime, unless the person is exempt. 0 means no overtime.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.submitOn: Each pay period, people submit their time for payroll. Set it per person in People.
approvals.submitOff: Off: people track time for reports only, and aren’t in payroll, unless set otherwise for them in People.
approvals.timesheetsOn: A submitted timesheet waits for the person’s manager or an admin.
approvals.timesheetsOff: Off: a submitted timesheet is final at once, with no one reviewing it.
approvals.timeOffOn: Vacation and sick time wait for the person’s manager or an admin before they count.
approvals.timeOffOff: Off: time off is recorded at once and counts toward payroll without review.

holidayPay.title: Holiday pay
holidayPay.label: Pay company holidays
holidayPay.on: People are paid the hours of each company holiday below, without recording any time. Set it per person in People.
holidayPay.off: Off: company holidays are shown but not paid, unless set otherwise for someone in People.

entries.title: Time entries
entries.requireDescription: Require a description on every entry
entries.requireDescriptionOn: People can start the timer without a description, but must add one before stopping it or saving completed time.
entries.requireDescriptionOff: Off: time can be recorded without a description.
entries.requireProject: Require a project on every entry
entries.requireProjectOn: People can start the timer without a project, but must choose one before stopping it or saving completed time.
entries.requireProjectOff: Off: time can be recorded with no project, and shows as “No project” in reports.
entries.longEntryHint: An entry or a running clock longer than this is flagged as an exception, usually a forgotten clock-out.
entries.allowPlannedTimeOn: People can add time ahead, up to a year out, such as a scheduled shift. It counts toward hours, overtime and payroll only as it passes, and a timesheet can’t be submitted while its period still has some.
entries.allowPlannedTimeOff: Off: time can be recorded up to now, not ahead.

payroll.invalid: A value is missing or out of range.

confirm.title: Change pay periods?
confirm.description: This moves every pay period boundary from now on. The current period becomes {current}, and the next {next}. Timesheets already submitted keep the period they were submitted for.

holidays.title: Company holidays
holidays.hint: Each holiday pays its hours to everyone with holiday pay, as Holiday hours beside vacation and sick. Holiday hours are never overtime. Enter the days the company observes them.
holidays.name: Name
holidays.daysHint: A holiday can cover several days. Each pays {hours} hours unless you set other hours for it.
holidays.empty: No holidays yet. Add the days your company observes, and everyone with holiday pay is paid for them.
holidays.deleteDescription: Its days are no longer paid. Days in submitted or approved timesheets can’t change until the timesheet is sent back.

catalog.title: Customers and projects
catalog.archiveNote: Archiving stops new time from being recorded and keeps everything already recorded in reports. Only customers with no projects, and projects with no time, can be deleted.

customer.name: Name
customer.archiveDescription: No new time can be recorded on any of its projects. Time already recorded stays in reports. You can unarchive it later.
customer.deleteDescription: A customer can be deleted only when it has no projects. This can’t be undone.
customer.inUse: This customer still has projects, so it can’t be deleted. Archive it to stop new time instead.

project.name: Name
project.codeHint: A charge code or contract number, shown in reports and exports. Optional.
project.billableOn: Time on this project is reported as billable to the customer.
project.billableOff: Time on this project is reported as not billable.
project.none: No projects yet. Add one so people can record time here.
project.archiveDescription: No new time can be recorded on it. Time already recorded stays in reports. You can unarchive it later.
project.deleteDescription: A project can be deleted only when no time was ever recorded on it. This can’t be undone.
project.inUse: This project has time recorded on it, so it can’t be deleted. Archive it to stop new time instead.
project.billableHint: Time on it can be billed to the customer. Reports show it as billable.
project.notBillableHint: Time on it isn’t billed to the customer, like internal work.

catalog.archivedHint: No new time can be recorded on it. Time already recorded stays in reports.

people.title: Everyone
people.sync: Bring in everyone from the directory
people.synced: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} in Timeclock after bringing in the directory.
people.syncFailed: Couldn’t bring people in from the directory.
people.empty: No one here yet. People appear when they first sign in, or bring everyone in from the directory.

notes.manager: Manager: who approves the person’s timesheets and time off. Left to the directory, it follows the host’s directory; with none, an admin approves.
notes.exempt: Overtime exempt: all of the person’s hours are regular, whatever the weekly threshold.
notes.payrollId: Payroll ID: the person’s id in Gusto, written to the payroll export.
notes.active: Active: inactive people are left out of reports and exceptions.
notes.timesheets: Timesheets: people who submit are in payroll. “Reports only” tracks time for project reports and the overview, with no timesheet and no payroll.
notes.holidayPay: Holiday pay: who is paid for the company holidays in Settings → Payroll. They’re paid without recording any time.

bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} selected
bulk.menu: Change {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
bulk.exempted: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} now overtime exempt.
bulk.unexempted: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} no longer overtime exempt.
bulk.activated: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} active again.
bulk.deactivated: {count, plural, one {# person was} other {# people were}} deactivated.
bulk.failed: Couldn’t change {count} of {total, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}.
bulk.hint: Select people, right-click one, or use ⋯ to change several at once.
bulk.timesheetsDefault: Use the workspace default for timesheets
bulk.madeSubmit: {count, plural, one {# person submits} other {# people submit}} timesheets now.
bulk.madeReportsOnly: {count, plural, one {# person tracks} other {# people track}} time for reports only now.
bulk.followDefault: {count, plural, one {# person follows} other {# people follow}} the workspace default for timesheets.
bulk.ownAdmin: You can’t remove your own admin.
bulk.madeAdmin: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} now an admin.
bulk.removedAdmin: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} no longer an admin.
bulk.holidayPayDefault: Use the workspace default for holiday pay
bulk.madePayHolidays: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} paid for company holidays now.
bulk.madeNoHolidayPay: {count, plural, one {# person isn’t} other {# people aren’t}} paid for company holidays now.
bulk.followHolidayDefault: {count, plural, one {# person follows} other {# people follow}} the workspace default for holiday pay.

people.adminFromHost: An admin in {host}: only {host} can change that.

exempt.title: Mark {who} overtime exempt?
exempt.description: All of their hours count as regular, whatever the weekly overtime threshold.

notExempt.title: Count overtime for {who}?
notExempt.description: Hours past the weekly threshold count as overtime again.

reportsOnly.title: Make {who} reports only?
reportsOnly.description: From now on they don’t submit timesheets and are left out of payroll. Their time still counts in reports and the overview.

submits.title: Require timesheets from {who}?
submits.description: They submit a timesheet each pay period, and their time is in payroll.

timesheetsDefault.title: Use the workspace default for {who}?
timesheetsDefault.description: Whether they submit timesheets follows Settings → Payroll.

makeAdmin.title: Make {who} an admin?
makeAdmin.description: Admins run payroll and manage Timeclock: they see everyone’s time, approve anything, change settings and people, and export reports.

removeAdmin.title: Remove admin from {who}?
removeAdmin.description: They’ll no longer run payroll or manage Timeclock. Admins from the host application stay admins.

activate.title: Make {who} active?
activate.description: They’re back in payroll reports, the Gusto export and exceptions.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {who}?
deactivate.description: They are left out of payroll reports, the Gusto export and exceptions from now on. Their recorded time is kept, and you can make them active again.

payHolidays.title: Pay {who} for company holidays?
payHolidays.description: Company holidays pay them their hours, as Holiday hours on their timesheet.

noHolidayPay.title: Stop paying {who} for company holidays?
noHolidayPay.description: Company holidays are shown on their timesheet but not paid.

holidayPayDefault.title: Use the workspace default for {who}?
holidayPayDefault.description: Whether company holidays pay them follows Settings → Payroll.

people.managerHint: Who approves their timesheets and time off. Left to the directory, it follows the host’s directory; with none, an admin approves.
people.payrollIdHint: Their id in Gusto, written to the payroll export.
people.exemptOn: All of their hours are regular.
people.exemptOff: Hours over the weekly threshold are overtime.
people.adminHint: Runs payroll: settings, people, projects and everyone’s time.
people.adminFromServer: An admin from their invitation or the server’s settings: it can’t be changed in People.

history.title: Changes to payroll data
history.filter: Show changes to one person’s time
history.empty: Nothing has changed yet. Every change to time, timesheets, time off and settings is listed here.
history.footer: The {count, plural, one {most recent change} other {# most recent changes}}, newest first. Times are in {zone}.

appearance.isOwn: This workspace uses Timeclock’s own look. Change a value and everything else follows.
appearance.isHost: This workspace matches {name}. Change a value to give it a look of its own.
appearance.isCustom: This workspace has its own look. Everyone sees it.
appearance.sidebarHint: Otherwise the sidebar is the background, a little deeper.
appearance.notDark: The dark mode’s background is a light color. Choose a darker one, or edit the light mode instead.
appearance.notLight: The light mode’s background is a dark color. Choose a lighter one, or edit the dark mode instead.
appearance.lowContrast: {mode}: {pair} is too faint to read. Raise the contrast or change a color.
appearance.pasteFailed: There is no theme on the clipboard.
appearance.wasReset: The workspace is back to the default look.

preference.title: Color theme
preference.hint: Choose how Timeclock looks in this browser.

invites.title: Invite people
invites.sent: {email} is invited. The link below is in their email; you can also pass it on yourself. It works for 7 days.
invites.adminHint: Will run payroll: settings, people, projects and everyone’s time.

sso.hosted: Sign-in is handled by the application Timeclock runs in.
sso.intro: Let this workspace’s people sign in through your own identity provider. What the provider says counts in this workspace only.
sso.issuerHint: The provider’s address. It is checked when you save.
sso.secretKept: Leave empty to keep the one saved.
sso.redirectHint: Give this to the provider as the allowed redirect.
sso.loginUrlHint: Goes straight to the provider. Give it to people the provider knows who aren’t in this workspace yet.
sso.requiredHint: A password no longer gets into this workspace.
sso.autoJoin: Let anyone the provider signs in join
sso.autoJoinHint: Otherwise only people already here or invited.
